sanskrit: uttamo asy oṣadhīnām anaḍvān jagatām iva vyāghraḥ śvapadām iva | yam aicchāmāvadāma taṃ pratispāśanam abruvan ||
english: Thou art the foremost of plants, as the bull among cattle, as the tiger among beasts of prey. That one whom we sought and declared — him they called a counter-snare.

sanskrit: sa id vyāghro bhavaty atho siṃho atho vṛṣā sarvā diśo vi rājati yo bibhartīmaṃ maṇim ||
english: He indeed becomes a tiger, and also a lion, and also a bull; he shines forth in all directions, he who bears this amulet.

sanskrit: nainaṃ ghnanty apsaraso na gandharvā na martyāḥ | sarvā diśo vi rājāti yo bibhartīmaṃ maṇim ||
english: The Apsarases do not smite him, nor the Gandharvas, nor mortal men; he shines forth in all directions, he who bears this amulet.

sanskrit: kaśyapas tvām asṛjata kaśyapas tvāṃ samairayat | abibhas tvendro mānuṣe bibhrat saṃśreṣiṇe 'jayat ||
english: Kaśyapa fashioned thee, Kaśyapa set thee in motion; Indra, bearing thee fearlessly among men, conquered by thee the one who clings close.

sanskrit: maṇiṃ sapatnajambhanaṃ varma devā abadhnata | yas tvā kṛtyābhir yas tvā dīkṣābhir yas tvā yajñair jighāṃsati | pratyak tvam indra taṃ jahi vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
english: The gods fastened this amulet, the crusher of rivals, as armour. He who seeks to slay thee with sorceries, he who seeks to slay thee with consecrations, he who seeks to slay thee with sacrifices — smite him back, O Indra, with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

sanskrit: ayam id vai pratīvartaḥ sahasvān sañjayo maṇiḥ | prajāṃ dhanaṃ ca rakṣatu paripāṇaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ ||
english: This is indeed the amulet that turns back, mighty and victorious; may it guard offspring and wealth — all-protecting, of great auspiciousness.

sanskrit: asapatnaṃ no adharād asapatnaṃ na uttarāt | indrāsapatnaṃ naḥ paścāj jyotiḥ śūra puras kṛdhi ||
english: Make us free of rivals from below, free of rivals from above; O Indra, O hero, place before us a light free of rivals, and behind us as well.

sanskrit: aindrāgnaṃ varma bahulaṃ yad ugraṃ viśve devā nāti vidhyanti sarve | tat te tanvaṃ trāyatāṃ sarvato bṛhad āyuṣmān jaradaṣṭir yathāsat ||
english: The broad, fierce armour belonging to Indra and Agni — which all the All-Gods together cannot pierce — let that great armour protect thy body from every side, so that thou mayest live long, reaching old age.

sanskrit: ā tvārukṣad devamaṇir mahyā ariṣṭatātaye | imaṃ methim abhisaṃviśadhvaṃ tanūpānaṃ trivarūtham ojase ||
english: The divine amulet has mounted thee for my unharmed continuance. Enter ye into this post, O ye who guard the body, triple-shielded, for vigour.

sanskrit: asminn indro ni dadhātu nṛmṇam imaṃ devāso abhisaṃviśadhvam | dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya- -āyuṣmān jaradaṣṭir yathāsat ||
english: May Indra deposit heroic power in this; enter ye, O gods, into this. For long life, for a hundred autumns — so may he live long, reaching old age.

sanskrit: indro badhnātu te maṇiṃ jigīvām̐ aparājitaḥ somapā abhayaṅkaro vṛṣā | sa tvā rakṣatu sarvadā divā naktaṃ ca viśvataḥ ||
english: May Indra bind the amulet upon thee — ever conquering, unconquered, drinking Soma, the bull who creates fearlessness; may he protect thee always, by day and by night, from every side.

sanskrit: indro manthatu manthitā śakraḥ śūraḥ purandaraḥ | yathā hanāma senām amitrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ ||
english: Let Indra churn, the churner, Śakra the hero, the breaker of strongholds — so that we may slay the army of enemies by the thousands.

sanskrit: pūtirajjur upadhmānī pūtiṃ senāṃ kṛṇotv amūm | agniṃ dhūmaṃ parādṛśya hṛtsv ā dadhatāṃ bhayam ||
english: Let the stinking rope, the blower-upon, make yonder army stinking; seeing before them fire and smoke, may they place fear in their own hearts.

sanskrit: paruṣān amūn paruṣāhvaḥ kṛṇotu hanty enān vadhako vadhaiḥ | kṣipraṃ śara iva bhajyantāṃ bṛhajjālena saṃjitāḥ ||
english: Let the Rough-named one make those ones rough; the slayer smites them with slaughters. Like arrows, let them quickly shatter, caught fast in the great net.

sanskrit: amūn aśvattha ni śṛṇīhi khādāmūn khadirājiram | tājadbhaṅga iva bhajyantāṃ bṛhajjālena saṃjitāḥ ||
english: Crush down yonder ones, O Aśvattha; gnaw yonder ones, O swift Khadira. Like the snapping of tāja-reeds let them break, caught fast in the great net.

sanskrit: antarikṣaṃ jālam āsīj jāladaṇḍā diśo mahīḥ | tenābhidāya senām indro dasyūn apāvapat ||
english: The atmosphere was the net, the great directions were the net-poles; having covered the army with that net, Indra swept away the Dasyus.

sanskrit: bṛhat te jālaṃ bṛhata indra śūra sahasrārghasya śatavīryasya | tenā ny ubja maghavann amitrān śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||
english: Great is thy net, O great Indra, O hero, worth a thousand, possessed of a hundredfold power; with that net, O Maghavan, press down the enemies through all the everlasting years.

sanskrit: bṛhat te jālaṃ bṛhataś śakrasya vājinīvataḥ | tenā śataṃ sahasram ayutaṃ jaghāna- -indro dasyūnām abhidhāya senām ||
english: Great is thy net, of the great Śakra possessed of troops; with it Indra slew a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand of the Dasyus, having covered their army.

sanskrit: ayaṃ loko jālam āsīc chakrasya mahato mahān | tenāham indrajālena tamasāmūn abhi dadhāmi sarvān ||
english: This great world was the net of the great Śakra; with that Indra-net and with darkness I cover all those yonder ones.

sanskrit: sedir ugrāvartir ārtiś cānapavācanā | śramas tandrīś ca mohaś ca tair amūn abhi dadhāmi sarvān ||
english: Exhaustion, fierce-whirling distress, and inescapable affliction, weariness and languor and bewilderment — with these I cover all those yonder ones.

sanskrit: mṛtyave amūn pra yacchāmi mṛtyupāśair amī sitāḥ | mṛtyor ye aghalā dūtās tebhya enān prati nayāmi baddhvā ||
english: I deliver those yonder ones to Death; they are bound by the nooses of Death. The sinister messengers of Death — to them I hand these over, having bound them.

sanskrit: mṛtyudūtā amūn nayata yamadūtā apombhata | paraḥ sahasrā hanyantāṃ tṛṇeḍhv enān matyaṃ bhavasya ||
english: O messengers of Death, lead those ones away; O messengers of Yama, submerge them. Let them be slain beyond the thousands; the weapon of Bhava crushes them.

sanskrit: sādhyā ekaṃ jāladaṇḍam udyatya yanty ojasā | rudrā dvitīyaṃ vasavas tṛtīyam ādityair eka udyataḥ ||
english: The Sādhyas go lifting one net-pole with vigour; the Rudras a second, the Vasus a third — one is lifted by the Ādityas.

sanskrit: viśve devā upariṣṭād ubjanto yantv ojasā | madhyena ghnanto yantu senām aṅgiraso vadhaiḥ ||
english: Let all the gods come pressing down from above with vigour; let the Aṅgirasas come striking in the middle, smiting the army with weapons.

sanskrit: vanaspatīn vānaspatyān oṣadhīr uta vīrudhaḥ | dvipāc catuṣpād iṣṇāmi yathā senām amūṃ hanat ||
english: Trees, the offspring of trees, plants, and herbs — bipeds and quadrupeds I urge on so that they may smite yonder army.

sanskrit: gandharvāpsaraso devān sarpān puṇyajanān pitṝn | dṛṣṭān adṛṣṭān iṣṇāmi yathā senām amūṃ hanat ||
english: Gandharvas and Apsarases, gods, serpents, beings of holy people, and the Fathers — seen and unseen ones I urge on so that they may smite yonder army.

sanskrit: mṛtyupāśā ime yuktā yān ākramya na mucyase | amuṣyā hantu senāyā idaṃ kūṭaṃ sahasraśaḥ ||
english: These nooses of Death are yoked — having stepped into which, thou art not released; let this snare smite that army by the thousands.

sanskrit: gharmaḥ samiddho agninā- -ayaṃ homaḥ sahasrahā | bhavaś ca pṛśnibāhuḥ śarva senām amūṃ hatam ||
english: The gharma-vessel blazes with fire; this oblation is the slayer of thousands. O Bhava of the speckled arm, and O Śarva, smite that army yonder.

sanskrit: mṛtyor oṣam ā padyantāṃ kṣudhaṃ sediṃ vadhaṃ bhayam | indraś cākṣujālābhyāṃ śarva senām amūṃ hatam ||
english: Let them fall upon the searing heat of Death, upon hunger, exhaustion, slaughter, and fear. O Indra with thy two eye-nets, and O Śarva, smite that army yonder.

sanskrit: parājitāḥ pra trasatāmitrā jitā dhāvata brahmaṇā | bṛhaspatipraṇuttānāṃ māmīṣāṃ moci kaś cana ||
english: Defeated, flee with trembling, O enemies, conquered and routed by the brahman-power; of these, driven forward by Bṛhaspati, let not one be released.

sanskrit: ava padyantām eṣām āyudhāni mā śakan pratidhām iṣum | athaiṣāṃ bahu bibhyatām iṣavo ghnantu marmaṇi ||
english: Let their weapons fall away; may they not be able to fix an arrow to the string. Then, of these greatly terrified ones, let arrows smite their vital spots.

sanskrit: sam enān krośatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe sam antarikṣaṃ saha devatābhiḥ | mā jñātāraṃ mā pratiṣṭhāṃ vidanta mitho 'pighnānā upa yantu mṛtyum ||
english: Let both Heaven and Earth roar together upon them; let the atmosphere together with the deities roar upon them. May they find neither kinsman nor firm footing; striking one another, let them go to Death.
